headline: Hajduk Split, fresh from beating Ajax, visit pointless Thun
summary: Hajduk Split beat Ajax 2-1 in their Conference League opener and now visit FC Thun, who are 30th of 36 with no points. Thun created just 0.2 expected goals in their opener at Twente. Blick reports that Thun coach Privitelli rejects the view that Hajduk are favourites. The market, with the bookmakers' margin removed, still gives Hajduk a 41.2% win chance, up from 39.9% in recent days. The main goals line is 3.0, which points to an open game. Thun's Nicolas Bürgy says even a draw would be valuable.
read: Hajduk Split come to Thun as the market favourites after beating Ajax, while Thun are 30th in the table with no points and have won only one of their last five. The market also expects an open game of about three goals, and Thun's camp says even a draw would be valuable.

facts.fact: Hajduk Split beat Ajax 2-1 at home in their Conference League opener last Thursday.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive with a big result in this competition.

facts.fact: Thun have won only 1 of their last 5 matches in all competitions: DLLWL, newest first.
facts.meaning: The hosts are in poor form coming into a European night.

facts.fact: In the 36-team Conference League table Hajduk are 10th with 3 points, while Thun are 30th with none.
facts.meaning: One side has a start to build on, the other already needs points at home.

facts.fact: In that opener at Twente, Thun created only 0.2 expected goals.
facts.meaning: The hosts barely threatened in their only European game so far.

facts.fact: Croatian journalists see Hajduk as the favourites, but Thun coach Privitelli disagrees, according to Blick.
facts.meaning: The Thun camp is not accepting the underdog label.

facts.fact: Thun player Nicolas Bürgy says that even a draw against the Ajax conqueror would be valuable, according to Blick.
facts.meaning: Thun would take a point from a team that has just beaten Ajax.

facts.fact: The match is rated a risk game and Bern cantonal police will be visibly present in Thun, according to 20 Minuten.
facts.meaning: Expect heavy security around the stadium on Thursday.

facts.fact: The market makes Hajduk the favourites, with a 41.2% chance to win away from home.
facts.meaning: Hajduk are the single most likely winner, though the visitors are well short of a certainty.

sources.fact: Hajduk Split beat Ajax in their Conference League league-phase opener, and Blick calls them the "Ajax conqueror" ahead of the trip to Thun.
Bluewin describes Hajduk Split as the leader of the Croatian league, a club that has been among the top contenders there for years.
Croatian journalists see Hajduk as the favourites, but Thun coach Privitelli disagrees, Blick reports.
Thun player Nicolas Bürgy says that even a draw against Hajduk, the team that beat Ajax, would be valuable for Thun.
The match is rated a risk game: Bern cantonal police will be visibly present in Thun on Thursday after Hajduk fans chanted pro-Nazi slogans before the Ajax game.
Croatian leaders condemned Hajduk hardcore fans for pro-Nazi chants during a march before the Ajax match, and police arrested at least a dozen fans afterwards.
Blick reports that Thun are carrying out special checks on their own fans before Hajduk's visit because the game counts as a risk match.
After Hajduk, Thun's next home game is against the leader of the Swiss Super League, so the Croatian league leader and the Swiss league leader visit Thun in turn.
